# 'md_dist' Dialect

_Domains, ownership, halos, and transfers between domains._

The `md_dist` dialect says where the values of a distributed
computation live and what moves between domains. Its values are global
views: one value of a distributed field stands for the rows of every
domain, and every op is collective over the domains of its
decomposition. Ownership (a layout) and halos are values, so that the
version of a field that a ghost holds, and the epoch of ownership of a
field, are facts of the IR that the verifier checks.

Nothing in this dialect names a transport: the same program runs with
every domain in one process or on separate ranks.


## Operations

### `md_dist.all_reduce` (::mdir::md_dist::AllReduceOp)

_Sums the partial sums of the domains_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.all_reduce` $partial attr-dict `:` qualified(type($partial)) `->` type($result)
```

The result is one value, the same on every domain. The partial sums
are added in the order of the domains.

```mlir
%u = md_dist.all_reduce %up : !md_dist.partial<f64> -> f64
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

### `md_dist.collect` (::mdir::md_dist::CollectOp)

_A field of the particle set from its owned rows_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.collect` $field `,` $layout attr-dict `:` qualified(type($field)) `->`
              qualified(type($result))
```

The inverse of `md_dist.distribute`: the values in the order of the
particle set, whatever the number of domains. The field must be
complete and of the layout.

```mlir
%f = md_dist.collect %fo, %l
       : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64> -> !md.field<@atoms, 3 x f64>
```

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

| :-----: | ----------- |

| `layout` | The ownership of the particles by the domains |

### `md_dist.covered` (::mdir::md_dist::CoveredOp)

_Collectively test whether a halo still covers a cutoff_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.covered` $halo `,` $reference `,` $current `,` $cell
              `cutoff` `(` $cutoff `)` attr-dict `:`
              qualified(type($halo)) `,` qualified(type($reference)) `->`
              type($result)
```

Return one predicate agreed by all domains. The reference positions and
cell must be exactly those of `halo`; the current positions belong to
the same ownership epoch but are a separate SSA value. Coverage holds
when twice the largest displacement of an owned particle in the wrapped
coordinate frame is strictly smaller than the halo reach minus `cutoff`.
A periodic wrap therefore invalidates coverage: the halo stores explicit
images. The cell must remain unchanged. Empty domains participate and
contribute zero displacement.

```mlir
%ok = md_dist.covered %halo, %reference, %current, %cell cutoff(2.0)
        : !md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.2>,
          !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64> -> i1
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

### `md_dist.decomposition` (::mdir::md_dist::DecompositionOp)

_Declares a Cartesian grid of domains over a particle set_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.decomposition` $sym_name `on` `(` $particle_set `)` `grid` `(` $grid `)` attr-dict
```

The domains are the boxes of a grid of `grid` divisions of each axis of
the cell, in its fractional coordinates: domain `(a, b, c)` is
`[a/ga, (a+1)/ga) x [b/gb, (b+1)/gb) x [c/gc, (c+1)/gc)`, numbered
`a + ga * (b + gb * c)`.

```mlir
md_dist.decomposition @dd on(@atoms) grid([2, 1, 1])
```

### `md_dist.distribute` (::mdir::md_dist::DistributeOp)

_The values of a field at the owned rows of each domain_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.distribute` $field `,` $layout (`image` `(` $image^ `)`)? attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($field)) `->` qualified(type($result))
```

With `image`, the values are positions, and each is wrapped into the
cell, so that it lies in the region of its domain.

```mlir
%xo = md_dist.distribute %x, %l image(%cell)
        : !md.field<@atoms, 3 x f64> -> !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
```

### `md_dist.gather_pairs` (::mdir::md_dist::GatherPairsOp)

_Sums a kernel, per owned particle, over its pairs_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.gather_pairs` $relation `,` $positions `,` $ghosts
              (`center_set` `(` $centerSet^ `:` qualified(type($centerSet)) `)`)?
              (`gather` `(` $gathered^ `:` qualified(type($gathered)) `)`)?
              `exchange` `(` $exchange `)` $kernel attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($relation)) `,` qualified(type($positions)) `,`
              qualified(type($ghosts)) `->` qualified(type($results))
```

```text
a_i = Σ_{k : (i, k) ∈ R} k(i, k)
```

The field of `md.gather_relation` at the owned rows. Over a `directed`
relation, every pair of `i` is at its owner, and with one result the
op is complete there (any kernel). Over a `unique` relation, the op
yields the contributions at owned rows and at ghost rows, both partial,
with `a = p + G^T q`: the kernel is evaluated once per pair, and the
value at `k` is the kernel's value under exchange, which `exchange`
states and the verifier proves.

Over a `directed` relation the op may yield the two partial results as
well (D276): every pair `(i, k)` of a domain adds
`½ k(i, k)` at `i` and `½ σ k(i, k)` at `k`, owned or ghost, again with
`a = p + G^T q`. It is the transpose of a directed `md_dist.sum_pairs`,
the form `md-differentiate` gives, and `md-dist-owner-computes` turns
it into the one complete result.

```mlir
%fo, %fg = md_dist.gather_pairs %n, %xo, %xg exchange(antisymmetric) {
  ...
} : !md_dist.relation<@dd, unique>, !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>,
    !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, 3 x f64>
    -> !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, partial, 3 x f64>,
       !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, partial, 3 x f64>
```

Traits: `AttrSizedOperandSegments`, `RecursiveMemoryEffects`, `SingleBlock`

### `md_dist.halo` (::mdir::md_dist::HaloOp)

_The ghosts of each domain at a configuration_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.halo` $layout `,` $positions `,` $cell attr-dict `:` qualified(type($positions))
              `->` qualified(type($result))
```

For each domain, every image `x_j + n H` of every particle, other than
the domain's own particles in the cell (`n = 0`), whose distance from
the region of the domain is less than the reach of the result type.
`positions` are the owned positions of `layout`.

```mlir
%h = md_dist.halo %l, %xo, %cell
       : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64> -> !md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.0>
```

### `md_dist.halo_copy` (::mdir::md_dist::HaloCopyOp)

_The owner-to-ghost copy G_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.halo_copy` $field `,` $halo (`image` `(` $image^ `)`)? attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($field)) `,` qualified(type($halo)) `->`
              qualified(type($result))
```

```text
(G a)_g = a_{s(g)}
```

Each ghost takes the value of its source. With `image`, the values are
positions and each ghost takes its image, `x_{s(g)} + n_g H`.

```mlir
%xg = md_dist.halo_copy %xo, %h image(%cell)
        : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>, !md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.0>
        -> !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, 3 x f64>
```

The adjoint of the op is `md_dist.halo_sum` (G^T).

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

### `md_dist.halo_sum` (::mdir::md_dist::HaloSumOp)

_An owned value plus the contributions of its ghosts, G^T_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.halo_sum` $owned `,` $ghosts `,` $halo attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($owned)) `,` qualified(type($ghosts)) `,`
              qualified(type($halo)) `->` qualified(type($result))
```

```text
r = a + G^T b,    (G^T b)_i = Σ_{g : s(g) = i} b_g
```

The values that the ghosts of every domain hold are summed at the
owners of their sources and added to `owned`. The result is complete.
G^T alone is the op with `owned` of `md_dist.zeros`.

The two operands are complete, or the two partial results of one
traversal: then the result is the traversal's sum, each contribution
counted once.

```mlir
%f = md_dist.halo_sum %fo, %fg, %h
       : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, partial, 3 x f64>,
         !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, partial, 3 x f64>,
         !md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.0>
       -> !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
```

The adjoint of the op is `md_dist.halo_copy` for `ghosts` and the
identity for `owned`.

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

### `md_dist.map_particles` (::mdir::md_dist::MapParticlesOp)

_Applies a kernel to each row of fields_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.map_particles` `gather` `(` $gathered `:` qualified(type($gathered)) `)`
              $kernel attr-dict `:` qualified(type($result))
```

```text
b_i = k(i)
```

The map of `md.map_particles` over the owned rows of fields of one
layout, or over the ghost rows of fields of one halo. The fields are
complete; the result is complete, of the same rows
(D276).

```mlir
%b = md_dist.map_particles gather(%a : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, f64>) {
^bb0(%a_i: f64):
  ...
  md_dist.yield %b_i : f64
} : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, f64>
```

### `md_dist.migrate` (::mdir::md_dist::MigrateOp)

_A new ownership epoch from current owned positions_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.migrate` $old_layout `,` $positions `,` $cell attr-dict `:`
              qualified(type($old_layout)) `,` qualified(type($positions))
              `->` qualified(type($layout))
```

Reassign every global particle identity to the domain containing its
current position, wrapped into `cell`. The result is a new layout SSA
value even if no owner changes. Rows within each destination are ordered
by global identity. Fields of `old_layout` must be redistributed before
use with the result; the old epoch remains valid for its existing users.

```mlir
%l2 = md_dist.migrate %l, %xo, %cell
        : !md_dist.layout<@dd>, !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
          -> !md_dist.layout<@dd>
```

### `md_dist.neighborhood` (::mdir::md_dist::NeighborhoodOp)

_The pairs within a cutoff, over owned and ghost rows_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.neighborhood` $positions `,` $ghosts `,` $halo `cutoff` `(` $cutoff `)` attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($positions)) `,` qualified(type($ghosts)) `,`
              qualified(type($halo)) `->` qualified(type($result))
```

The relation of `md.neighborhood` over the local rows of each domain.
`positions` are owned positions and `ghosts` their copy through `halo`,
with images. With the traversal `directed`, a domain holds the pairs
`(i, k)` of an owned `i` and any other local row `k` within `cutoff`;
with `unique`, those where the identity of `i` is less than that of
the source of `k`.

```mlir
%n = md_dist.neighborhood %xo, %xg, %h cutoff(2.0)
       : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>,
         !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, 3 x f64>, !md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.0>
       -> !md_dist.relation<@dd, directed>
```

### `md_dist.partition` (::mdir::md_dist::PartitionOp)

_The layout that gives each particle to the domain it is in_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.partition` $positions `,` $cell attr-dict `:` qualified(type($positions)) `->`
              qualified(type($layout))
```

Each particle is owned by the domain whose region holds its position,
wrapped into the cell. Within a domain the owned rows are in the order
of the particle set.

```mlir
%l = md_dist.partition %x, %cell
       : !md.field<@atoms, 3 x f64> -> !md_dist.layout<@dd>
```

### `md_dist.partition_centers` (::mdir::md_dist::PartitionCentersOp)

_Partition owned centers by ghost membership in one relation_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.partition_centers` $relation `,` $layout `,` $halo attr-dict `:` qualified(type($relation))
              `,` qualified(type($layout)) `,` qualified(type($halo)) `->`
              qualified(type($interior)) `,` qualified(type($boundary))
```

The interior indicator is one exactly where no pair of this relation
centered on the owned row reads a ghost neighbor. The boundary indicator
is its complement. Both indicators have one i32 component over the owned
rows of the relation's layout, with values exactly zero or one. The
relation must have been built after its position halo completed; the
operation cannot justify overlapping that same position transfer.

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

### `md_dist.redistribute` (::mdir::md_dist::RedistributeOp)

_Carry a complete owned field to a new ownership epoch_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.redistribute` $field `,` $old_layout `,` $new_layout
              (`image` `(` $image^ `)`)? attr-dict `:` qualified(type($field))
              `,` qualified(type($old_layout)) `,` qualified(type($new_layout))
              `->` qualified(type($result))
```

Copy each value by its stable global particle identity from `old_layout`
to `new_layout`. With `image`, wrap a three-component position field into
the new cell. The result belongs to `new_layout`; no old field or layout
buffer is modified or retired by this op.

```mlir
%x2 = md_dist.redistribute %xo, %l, %l2 image(%cell)
        : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>,
          !md_dist.layout<@dd>, !md_dist.layout<@dd>
          -> !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

### `md_dist.sum_pairs` (::mdir::md_dist::SumPairsOp)

_Sums a kernel over the pairs of a relation_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.sum_pairs` $relation `,` $positions `,` $ghosts
              (`center_set` `(` $centerSet^ `:` qualified(type($centerSet)) `)`)?
              (`gather` `(` $gathered^ `:` qualified(type($gathered)) `)`)?
              `exchange` `(` $exchange `)` $kernel attr-dict
              `:` qualified(type($relation)) `,` qualified(type($positions)) `,`
              qualified(type($ghosts)) `->` qualified(type($result))
```

```text
S = Σ_d S_d,  S_d = ½ Σ_{(i,k) ∈ D_d} k(i, k)   (directed)
              S_d =   Σ_{(i,k) ∈ U_d} k(i, k)   (unique)
```

The sum of `md.sum_relation` over the global relation, each pair once;
the result holds the part of each domain. The kernel receives the
distance, the displacement `x_i − x_k`, and two values of each gathered
field, of `i` and of `k`; it must be symmetric under exchange of the
two, which the verifier proves.

`gather` takes each field as its owned value and its ghost copy through
the relation's halo.

```mlir
%u = md_dist.sum_pairs %n, %xo, %xg exchange(symmetric) {
^bb0(%r: f64, %d: vector<3xf64>):
  ...
  md_dist.yield %k : f64
} : !md_dist.relation<@dd, directed>, !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>,
    !md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, 3 x f64> -> !md_dist.partial<f64>
```

### `md_dist.sum_particles` (::mdir::md_dist::SumParticlesOp)

_Sums a kernel over the rows of fields_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.sum_particles` `gather` `(` $gathered `:` qualified(type($gathered)) `)`
              $kernel attr-dict `:` qualified(type($result))
```

Over owned rows, the sum of `md.sum_particles`, each particle once.
Over ghost rows, the inner product of the space of the ghosts, which
no physical sum is, and which the test of the adjoint of `halo_copy`
uses. The fields are of one role and of one layout or halo.

```mlir
%k = md_dist.sum_particles gather(%v : !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>) {
^bb0(%v_i: vector<3xf64>):
  ...
  md_dist.yield %e : f64
} : !md_dist.partial<f64>
```

Traits: `RecursiveMemoryEffects`, `SingleBlock`

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `gathered` | variadic of A field over the owned or the ghost rows of every domain |

#### Results:

| Result | Description |
| :----: | ----------- |
| `result` | One partial sum per domain |



### `md_dist.yield` (::mdir::md_dist::YieldOp)

_Yields the value of a kernel_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.yield` attr-dict ($values^ `:` type($values))?
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`, `HasParent<SumPairsOp, GatherPairsOp, SumParticlesOp, MapParticlesOp>`, `ReturnLike`, `Terminator`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`, `RegionBranchTerminatorOpInterface`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `values` | variadic of any non-token type |



### `md_dist.zeros` (::mdir::md_dist::ZerosOp)

_A field of zeros over the owned rows or the ghosts_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `md_dist.zeros` $rows attr-dict `:` qualified(type($rows)) `->` qualified(type($result))
```

Over the owned rows of a layout, or over the ghosts of a halo.

```mlir
%z = md_dist.zeros %l : !md_dist.layout<@dd>
       -> !md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `rows` | The ownership of the particles by the domains or The ghosts of each domain |

#### Results:

| Result | Description |
| :----: | ----------- |
| `result` | A field over the owned or the ghost rows of every domain |



## Types

### FieldType

_A field over the owned or the ghost rows of every domain_

The values of a per-particle field at the owned rows of every domain,
or at the ghost rows of a halo.

```mlir
!md_dist.field<@dd, owned, 3 x f64>
!md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, 3 x f64>
```

`partial` marks contributions to a sum that is not complete: those a
traversal that computes each pair once leaves at owned rows and at
ghost rows. Only `md_dist.halo_sum` consumes a partial field, and a
partial value has exactly one use.

```mlir
!md_dist.field<@dd, ghost, partial, 3 x f64>
```

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| decomposition | `::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr` |  |
| role | `::mdir::md_dist::Role` | an enum of type Role |
| partial | `bool` |  |
| numComponents | `unsigned` |  |
| elementType | `::mlir::Type` |  |

### HaloType

_The ghosts of each domain_

For each domain, its ghosts: every image of every particle, other than
the domain's own particles in the cell, within `reach` of the domain's
region. Each ghost records its source (owner and owned row), its global
identity, and its image. The reach is in the type, so that coverage is
checked where the halo is used.

```mlir
!md_dist.halo<@dd, 2.0>
```

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| decomposition | `::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr` |  |
| reach | `::llvm::APFloat` | the reach |

### LayoutType

_The ownership of the particles by the domains_

Syntax:

```
!md_dist.layout<
  ::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr   # decomposition
>
```

For each particle of the set of the decomposition, the domain that owns
it, its row among the owned rows of that domain, and its global
identity, its place in the particle set. A layout never changes; a
migration gives a new layout, so that a layout value is an epoch of
ownership.

```mlir
!md_dist.layout<@dd>
```

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| decomposition | `::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr` |  |

### PartialType

_One partial sum per domain_

Syntax:

```
!md_dist.partial<
  ::mlir::Type   # valueType
>
```

The contribution of each domain to a sum over all of them: the energy
of the pairs a domain holds, for one. Only `md_dist.all_reduce`
consumes it, and a partial value has exactly one use.

```mlir
!md_dist.partial<f64>
!md_dist.partial<vector<9xf64>>
```

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| valueType | `::mlir::Type` |  |

### RelationType

_The pairs within a cutoff, over the rows of each domain_

Syntax:

```
!md_dist.relation<
  ::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr,   # decomposition
  `directed` | `unique`   # traversal
>
```

The relation of `md.neighborhood`, realized over the owned and ghost
rows of each domain: with `directed`, every pair at the owner of each
of its two particles; with `unique`, every pair once.

```mlir
!md_dist.relation<@dd, directed>
```

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| decomposition | `::mlir::FlatSymbolRefAttr` |  |
| traversal | `::mdir::md_dist::Traversal` | an enum of type Traversal |
